source_metadata.title: Landmark clinical trials shaping contemporary guideline-directed medical therapy for heart failure

extraction_limitations: The source is a narrative clinical review, not an original randomized trial or systematic review. Trial results are represented as findings reported by this review and tagged secondary_reported_result.
The LiteratureAtom schema is oriented to primary literature and has no dedicated narrative-review synthesis or guideline-recommendation atom kind.
Bibliography entries were not atomized. The separate xvag141-references.md file contains the 135 cited references.
Atoms remain review_status=needs_review because this run did not include a separate human source-verification step.
schema_gaps: No dedicated atom kind represents secondary-review synthesis or practice-guideline recommendation language.
QuantitativeResult supports one principal estimate, so rows with multiple distinct subgroup or secondary estimates were split into separate atoms where needed.
